correctness.rationale: The source gives an exhaustive stabilizer/fixed-locus classification. H is contained in SL(3,C), hence has no nonidentity pseudoreflections, so every nontrivial H-stabilizer produces a quotient singularity. The fixed loci give 63 generic C2, 28 generic C3, and 21 generic C4 elliptic components. Their setwise stabilizer orders 8, 6, and 8 yield orbit sizes 21, 28, and 21, hence 3+1+1 image curves. The tangent eigenvalues give transverse A1, A2, and A3. Proposition 3.1 supplies exactly two isolated order-seven quotient points. The embedded verifier independently replays the orbit arithmetic and local cyclic-quotient relations.

value.rationale: The intermediate quotient Y is singled out in the sequel as a natural Calabi--Yau orbifold whose non-isolated singularities are left for future study. The result supplies the first structural decomposition needed for such a study: the exact number of singular-locus components, their generic ADE profile, and how four curve components disappear from the singular locus after adjoining -1. This is a natural global invariant of the named quotient, not an arbitrary parameter slice or table recomputation.
